Name: the Bloody Hand Gang
Description: The Bloody Hand Gang is a criminal terrorist group that is wealthy, ruthless, barbaric, and very dangerous, and well-hated across the stars for being somewhat sneaky and mean-spirited in their ways.  Their members include battlemech pilots, and they can and will involve battlemechs in their activities.  They are notorious for kidnapping people and holding them for ransom, as well as robbing and stealing from towns, cities, banks, and even military bases of all things.
